stem:
The diagram shows Reyansh's two simple pendulums in the lab. Both have the same string length at the same place. Pendulum P has a wooden-bead bob. Pendulum Q has a metal-nut bob. He sets both swinging with small oscillations.

Which statement about their time periods is correct?

options.text: P and Q have the same time period, because time period depends on length, not on the mass of the bob.
Q has a longer time period, because time period depends on the mass of the bob, not on length.
P and Q have the same time period at every place on Earth, because length alone fixes the time period everywhere.
Any two periodically moving objects of this length have the same time period at this place.

teacher.key_rationale: At a given place, for small swings, time period depends on length not bob mass, so equal lengths give equal periods. Mass does not set the period; length alone does not fix the period at every place; not every periodic object of that length matches a simple pendulum.
teacher.figure_note: Rewrote force block into two equal-length pendulums with wood and metal bobs.
